_description: Pre-Notion filter rules. Applied BEFORE creating Notion pages. Jobs matching these rules go straight to Archive in TSV, never reach Notion.

company_cap.note: ATS systems may deprioritize candidates with too many applications to same company

company_blocklist._description: Companies where ALL roles are a weak fit for this candidate. Auto-archive.

title_blocklist._description: Title patterns that auto-archive regardless of company. Matched case-insensitively as substrings.

role_targets._description: RFC 030 / RFC 033 — single source of truth for acceptable role-tracks. Read by scan (title gate) and by LLM prepare (Fit Score). At least one track with one or more patterns is REQUIRED (RFC 033) — without it the engine has no positive title gate.

fit_treatments.primary: Apply Fit Score by domain match only. Track is the candidate's main target.
fit_treatments.bridge: Bridge/stepping-stone role. Apply standard domain logic but never downgrade purely for being on this track instead of the primary one.

tracks._comment: Replace this placeholder with one or more real tracks before running the engine. Substring match, case-insensitive.
tracks.name: Your Role Track

location_rules._description: Restrict to specific locations / remote-only. Empty = no location filter.
